The deconvolution of the O 1s spectrum of CZnOntsCC Fig. 3b consists of four peaks at 530.7 eV, 531.6, 532.6 eV and 533.7eV, which are attributed to scriptstyle 0 - mathrm C 0 , 02 - , mathrm C - 0 and C–O–Zn species 41.02 - originates from the oxygen in zinc oxide 42. The appearance of mathrm C mathrm - mathrm O - mathrm bond further proves that zinc oxide may react with the carboxyl group in carbon fiber, resulting in the bonding between carbon and zinc through oxygen, ultimately forming C–O–Zn connection 43. The detection on C–O–Zn formation is consistent with the growth mechanism of zinc oxide grown under hydrothermal conditions 44.
